_comment: Measures whose Yes share is read against a rule other than a plain majority of the votes shown, by civicAPI race id. needs: the share Yes must reach; label: how the words print it; text: the sentence on the race card. build.py copies the entry onto the race as `rule`, fails if an id is not a measure in the search, and prints a note when civicAPI's call disagrees with the rule. Verified Nov. 8, 2026 against each state's rule; a Colorado amendment that only repeals constitutional language (Amendment 87) needs a majority and is not listed.
